summary.text: Hope Damon is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives who has represented Sullivan 8 since December 2022 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Hope Damon lives in Sullivan County, New Hampshire, and earned a degree from Framingham State College.
Her career experience includes working as a registered dietitian and diabetes educator and as a food and nutrition services director at New London Hospital.
She founded The Nutrition Counseling Center in 1987 and previously volunteered as president of the New Hampshire Dietetic Association.
Damon assumed office on December 7, 2022, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
